description: DESIGN ARTIFACT ONLY. This file is a design proposal for the Question -> MicroSkill mapping layer. It is NOT seeded to the database. It is produced by the QuestionSkillMapping DESIGN phase, which is review-only.

authority.microSkillSource: database (MicroSkill, 70 rows, MEB 11th grade math curriculum)

semantics.primary: The single MicroSkill the question is fundamentally designed to measure. Maximum 1 per question.
semantics.secondary: A MicroSkill genuinely required to solve the question, but not the measurement target. 0..N per question.
semantics.relevance: How strongly the MicroSkill relates to the question. Range 0.0-1.0.
semantics.confidence: How certain we are that the mapping itself is correct. Range 0.0-1.0. Stored in schema field aiConfidence.
semantics.mappingSource: Provenance of the mapping. Manual review = MANUAL_REVIEW.

constraints.questionToErrorPatternMapping: OUT OF SCOPE for this layer

summary.reason: Assessed question corpus contains no curriculum-aligned, grade-11 mathematics content. No defensible Question -> MicroSkill mapping can be produced. See question-skill-mapping-review.md.

unmappedQuestions.note: All 159 questions are unmapped. Reason categories are assigned per question class below rather than repeating 159 entries.

reasonCategories.description: Content is single-digit addition drills such as "What is 2 + 2?". Not grade-11 mathematics. Belongs to no Theme/LearningOutcome/ProcessComponent/MicroSkill in the 70-skill set.
Content is literal placeholder strings such as "Question 1", "Question 2", "Question", "Test question". No mathematical task is expressed, so no MicroSkill can be identified.

Content is real mathematics (linear function evaluation, function definition) but the topic (functions) is not part of the MEB grade-11 Themes represented by the 70 MicroSkills. There is no valid MicroSkill target.

designExemplars.note: Illustrative mapping rows showing the intended output SHAPE for a future, curriculum-aligned question corpus. These are NOT derived from existing database questions and MUST NOT be seeded as-is. Their questionIds are placeholders.
